title: The Caves of Steel
author: Isaac Asimov
summary: In a future New York of enclosed cities, detective Elijah Baley must solve the murder of a scientist from a spacer colony. He is partnered with R. Daneel Olivaw, a humanoid robot.
readIf: you like classic science fiction that works as a murder mystery.
skipIf: you want modern pacing or a lot of technical space action.
